data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation misclassifies 'shared mechanism.' Both SRC_005 and SRC_006 apply a single rate globally — but they do not share a mechanism in the problem's sense (a common explanatory structure producing the outputs). They are independent flat-rate collapses that land on opposite extremes. Calling 'a threshold-blind scalar applied to all hours' a shared mechanism is a description of a shared defect, not a shared causal/structural mechanism tying the artifacts together. The real relation is symmetric contradiction via divergent collapse, not shared mechanism; the target conflates the two.
